questions.question_en: Which drainage relationship correctly identifies Delta growth condition?

options: Sediment accumulation at a river mouth sustained relative to removal
Reservoir retention reducing some downstream sediment delivery
Storage and release changing downstream timing of flows
Interaction of river freshwater and marine water in a coastal basin
